parameters.help_en: The name of the directional group. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and underscores (_), and can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
给定向分组设置一个名称。

分组名称支持中文、英文、数字及下划线（_），长度不超过30个字符

Data.description_en: The ID of the directional group. Record the ID of the directional group. You must specify the ID when you call other operations, such as [AddDirectionalCard]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/446808.html） to import IoT cards into the directional group
Data.description_zh:
定向分组ID。
